dayz-build-pbo.description: Pack an existing mod from workspace/<ModName>/ into a PBO

dayz-lint.description: Check a mod for errors that would stop it loading, before packing

dayz-launch-test.description: Launch the local DayZ Diag test server and client

dayz-stop-test.description: Stop a running local DayZ test session

dayz-preflight.description: Check the DayZ modding environment (P: drive, DayZ Tools)

dayz-gate.description: Behavior test: a test mission spawns and uses each new item and gives PASS or FAIL per check

dayz-new-mod.description: Scaffold an empty new mod folder, no content

dayz-server-admin.description: Server economy and config: types.xml, spawns, loot, init.c, serverDZ.cfg, cfggameplay.json

dayz-config-specialist.description: config.cpp work: CfgPatches, CfgVehicles, CfgWeapons, inheritance, hidden selections

dayz-script-specialist.description: Write or change Enforce Script (.c) code, modded classes, RPCs

dayz-ui-specialist.description: UI work: .layout files, HUD, menus, widgets

dayz-object-builder.description: Model work in Object Builder: .p3d LODs, named selections, proxies

dayz-mod-debugger.description: Diagnose a crash, error or log: script.log, RPT, crash.log

dayz-mod-reviewer.description: Review or audit a mod for convention problems before building or release

dayz-asset-specialist.description: Textures and materials: pack images to .paa, write .rvmat files

dayz-map-specialist.description: Terrain and map building: Terrain Builder, heightmaps, layers.cfg, surfaces, clutter, DayZ Editor imports

dayz-workbench-specialist.description: Enfusion Workbench plugins: editor-time tools and batch automation for DayZ Tools

dayz-build-engineer.description: Turn a finished mod into a test build the user can play: build the PBO, set up the server, launch a session

dayz-docs-writer.description: A mod's README, changelog, install notes and classname list for server owners

orchestrator.description: Build a whole new mod with many parts (plan, team, build, test)

figma-node-normalizer.description: Start the Figma pipeline: turn a Figma design or figma.com link into a checked DayZ .layout
